target_customer: Nigerian businesses of all sizes, plus fintechs and platforms using the payroll API, and workers seeking early wage access
problem: Nigerian businesses struggle with manual payroll, tax, pension and statutory remittances, and workers lack timely access to earned pay.
business_model: Payroll SaaS and API with fees on payroll and remittances, plus lending and early wage access products

founders.name: Asher Adeniyi
founders.background_notes: Education, employers and prior startups not found in opened sources. Search-result summaries of aggregator pages mention an earlier jobs site and two further co-founders (Efosa Uwoghiren, Kingsley Michael); not confirmed by the YC page or company site, so not recorded.

competitors.name: SeamlessHR
competitors.funding_then: 10M USD Series A led by TLcom Capital in January 2022; total 12.2M USD

competitors.name: Earnipay
competitors.what: On-demand salary access for Nigerian employees

technical_complexity.rationale: Payroll calculation with Nigerian PAYE and pension rules and payments integration; standard SaaS with local compliance detail.

defensibility.rationale: Payroll records create some lock-in, but several funded rivals existed and nothing prevented copying.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copy found; funded HR platforms kept growing.

market_need_then: Company says it serves over 10,000 businesses (YC page) and 15,000 (2025 sponsored article); demand evidence at founding is not independently sourced.

identity.voice_and_tone: Stress-relief promise: Your payroll, tax and compliance stress ends here

brand_strength.rationale: Easy but near-identical to Earnipay, which raised more and was covered by TechCrunch; promoted through paid brand-press content.

outcome_analysis: Eazipay is a Lagos payroll and compliance platform from YC Winter 2022 that now claims thousands of business customers and a payroll API. No funding beyond YC was found in reliable sources, and growth claims come from the company and sponsored content. It appears to have grown capital-efficiently but evidence is thin.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators report a YC investment of 125K USD (Jan 2022, with Ajim Capital and FoundersX Ventures) and a bouncewatch page lists 500K and 2M USD; these conflict, so no round is recorded. Eazipay is not Earnipay. Competitor sources were seen as search results, not opened. Customer counts are company claims. Education and employers not found.
